name: AnimationPoints
description: Represents a collection of animation points for a PropertyEffect object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Smooth
properties.description: Determines whether the transition from one animation point to another is smoothed. Read/write.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single AnimationPoint object from the specified AnimationPoints collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single AnimationPoint object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns an AnimationPoint object that represents a new animation point.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The position of the animation point in relation to other animation points. The default value is -1, which means that if you omit the Index parameter, the new animation point is added to the end of existing animation points.
